# Annotexia

Version: 1.0
Last Updated: July 2026

## Company

Annotexia is an AI data annotation and data labeling company providing high-quality training datasets for Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), Robotics, and Generative AI applications.

Our annotation teams deliver scalable, secure, and quality-controlled datasets for startups, enterprises, research organizations, and AI product companies worldwide.

Website:
https://annotexia.com

Contact:
https://annotexia.com/contact

About:
https://annotexia.com/about

---

# Core Services

## Image Annotation

High-quality image annotation services for Computer Vision AI.

Includes:

* Bounding Box Annotation
* Polygon Annotation
* Semantic Segmentation
* Instance Segmentation
* Keypoint Annotation
* Landmark Annotation
* Cuboid Annotation
* Image Classification
* OCR Annotation

https://annotexia.com/services/image-annotation

---

## Video Annotation

Frame-by-frame video annotation services.

Includes:

* Object Tracking
* Player Tracking
* Ball Tracking
* Event Detection
* Action Recognition
* Pose Estimation
* Lane Detection
* Vehicle Tracking
* Multi-object Tracking

https://annotexia.com/services/video-annotation

---

## Text Annotation

Natural Language Processing annotation services.

Includes:

* Named Entity Recognition
* Text Classification
* Intent Classification
* Sentiment Analysis
* Relation Extraction
* Entity Linking
* Prompt Annotation
* RLHF
* LLM Training Data

https://annotexia.com/services/text-annotation

---

## Audio Annotation

Speech and voice AI annotation services.

Includes:

* Speech Transcription
* Speaker Identification
* Intent Annotation
* Emotion Detection
* Audio Classification
* Acoustic Event Detection

https://annotexia.com/services/audio-annotation

---

## Data Labeling

Enterprise data labeling solutions for AI and Machine Learning.

https://annotexia.com/services/data-labeling

# Annotation Formats

Supported output formats include:

* COCO
* YOLO
* Pascal VOC
* JSON
* XML
* CSV
* TXT
* Custom Client Formats

# Annotation Tools

Our teams work with:

* CVAT
* Label Studio
* Labelbox
* SuperAnnotate
* Supervisely
* Roboflow
* V7 Darwin
* Doccano
* Custom Annotation Platforms

# Quality

Annotexia follows structured quality assurance workflows including:

* Annotation Guidelines
* Multi-Level Review
* Random Sampling
* Consistency Validation
* Client Feedback Integration
